mapper.insert:
insert into cr_eval_train_task (resource_id, `status`, mission_id, user_id, user_answer, release_time, room_id, role_id, business_type, mission_template_id, eval_template_id, last_submit_time, task_start_time, score, create_time, update_time) values
(#{item.resourceId}, #{item.status}, #{item.missionId}, #{item.userId},#{item.userAnswer}, #{item.releaseTime}, #{item.roomId},#{item.roleId}, #{item.businessType}, #{item.missionTemplateId},#{item.evalTemplateId}, #{item.lastSubmitTime}, #{item.taskStartTime}, #{item.score}, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: select a.resource_id taskId, b.resource_id submitId, b.score, a.mission_id missionId, a.user_id userId, a.role_id roleId, a.room_id roomId FROM cr_eval_train_task a JOIN cr_eval_task_submit b on a.resource_id = b.task_id where a.eval_template_id = #{evalTemplateId}
